title: Cherrypicking with Multi-Channel Pipette and CSV
author: Opentrons
materials: Target cell is dispensed into 384 well-plate.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a CSV following the provided template: each entry is formatted as "reservoirWell/effectorWell" (use "0" for no effector, "x" for wells to be skipped). Do not place commas inside well identifiers. Set the mount column to exactly "left" or "right". In the pre‑mix column start the cell with "Yes" or "No" (any text may follow). Include the numeric Transfer Volume Effector Cell (µL) and the pre‑mix height (well‑plate units) for each row.

substeps.instruction: Download the template from the link in the protocol.
Enter well identifiers according to the rules above.
Enter numeric values for Transfer Volume Effector Cell and pre‑mix height.
Save the file without extra commas.

steps.title: Upload CSV to protocol
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons protocol interface, upload the prepared CSV file; the same file will be used later for Part 2 (effector cell loading).

steps.title: Determine tip count
steps.instruction: The protocol parses the CSV, counts the number of distinct target‑cell wells, and calculates how many 8‑channel tip sets are required; a fresh tip set will be used for each target‑cell transfer.

steps.title: Pick up tips
steps.instruction: Load the 8‑channel pipette with the calculated number of tip racks and pick up the first set of tips.

steps.title: Aspirate target cell
steps.instruction: For each target‑cell entry, aspirate the specified Transfer Volume (µL) from the reservoir well. If the pre‑mix column is "Yes", perform a pre‑mix at the indicated pre‑mix height before aspirating. Use a new tip set for each target‑cell transfer.

steps.title: Dispense to 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Multi‑dispense the aspirated volume into the listed 384‑well plate wells, dispensing as many wells as the tip can accommodate before returning to the reservoir for a fresh aspirate.

steps.title: Add controls
steps.instruction: For any CSV entry marked with a lowercase "x", add the appropriate control reagent to the corresponding 384‑well plate well (no cell transfer).

steps.title: Repeat for remaining entries
steps.instruction: Continue the aspirate‑dispense‑control cycle for all rows in the CSV; after each target‑cell transfer, discard the used tip set and pick up a new set before processing the next entry.
